clips.title: The story
paras: High Overlord Saurfang is a legendary orc warrior and a veteran of the Old Horde's wars. Serving as Warchief Thrall's trusted military commander in Orgrimmar, he represents the proud martial spine of the modern Horde.

Few living warriors possess a martial pedigree to rival Saurfang. A veteran of the Old Horde's wars, he is considered an unstoppable force on the battlefield. Today he stands in Orgrimmar as High Overlord, a bulwark of Thrall's newborn Horde.

Though he stands as an unmatched champion of the Horde, Saurfang is not driven by reckless battle-lust. While he will relentlessly defend the Horde and enforce Thrall's rule against any threat, Saurfang harbors a profound disdain for warmongering and fights strictly for honor and preservation.
